description: Curated starter reference library for Davis AI. Each entry is a concise original summary with authoritative further-reading links. Verify time-sensitive claims against live official sources.

documents.title: Human Anatomy and Physiology Foundations
documents.content: Anatomy studies body structures and their relationships; physiology studies how those structures function. Structure and function are interdependent. The body is organised from chemical level to organelles, cells, tissues, organs, organ systems and the whole organism. The four primary tissue classes are epithelial, connective, muscle and nervous tissue. Homeostasis is the regulation of internal conditions within ranges compatible with life, commonly through negative-feedback loops involving a receptor, control centre and effector. Positive feedback amplifies a process until a defined endpoint, such as labour contractions. When teaching a body system, connect gross anatomy, microscopic structure, normal function, regulation and clinical relevance. These notes are an introductory map, not a substitute for a complete textbook or local course syllabus.

documents.title: Nursing Foundations: Safety, Evidence and Patient-Centred Care
documents.content: Safe nursing practice begins with patient identification, clear communication, hand hygiene, infection prevention, accurate documentation, respect for dignity and privacy, and timely escalation when a patient deteriorates. Clinical decisions should use current evidence, the patient's assessment findings, applicable professional standards and local facility protocols. Educational explanations must not be treated as patient-specific orders. Never invent drug doses, diagnoses, procedures or institutional policy. If a clinical situation is urgent, direct the user to qualified clinicians and emergency services rather than relying on an AI response.

documents.title: Research Literacy and Source Evaluation
documents.content: Evaluate a source by authority, relevance, currency, evidence quality, transparency and purpose. Prefer primary research for specific study findings, systematic reviews for synthesis, and authoritative agencies for public-health or regulatory guidance. Check the publication date and whether the page has been updated; distinguish the date an event occurred from the date an article was published. Follow references to the underlying report or study where possible. Compare independent sources, identify limitations and conflicts of interest, and avoid treating search-result snippets as sufficient evidence. Clearly separate sourced facts, interpretation and recommendations. If evidence is unavailable or conflicting, say so rather than filling gaps with speculation.

sources.label: WHO – Resources and evidence-based health information

documents.title: Uganda Higher-Education Verification Guide
documents.content: For questions about whether a Ugandan higher-education institution is licensed, or whether a programme is accredited or recognised, verify against the National Council for Higher Education (NCHE) official website and the relevant institution or programme record. Do not infer that an institution's licence automatically proves that every programme, campus, intake or delivery mode is approved. Record the exact institution name, programme title, award, campus, status and date checked. Because registers and regulatory decisions can change, this library entry is a verification procedure, not a current accreditation determination. Use the official register and notices for the latest position.

documents.title: Web Development and JavaScript Fundamentals
documents.content: A web application commonly has a client interface, a server/API layer and optional persistent storage. The browser should not contain private API keys or privileged credentials; keep secrets on the server and expose only the minimum required endpoints. Validate incoming data on the server, enforce authentication and authorisation where needed, apply rate limits, handle errors explicitly and avoid logging secrets or personal data. JavaScript supports asynchronous operations such as promises and async/await; handle rejected promises and network failures. Use version control, small changes, automated checks and staged deployments. Never claim code was tested unless the test actually ran.

documents.title: Business Planning and Decision Fundamentals
documents.content: A practical business plan identifies a specific customer problem, target segment, proposed value, delivery model, revenue assumptions, costs, competitors, risks and measurable milestones. Separate assumptions from verified facts. Test demand with low-cost experiments before making large commitments. Track cash flow separately from accounting profit; include fixed and variable costs, working capital and a realistic contingency. Marketing should define an audience, a clear offer, credible evidence, a channel and a measurable call to action. Avoid guaranteeing income or presenting forecasts as certain outcomes.

sources.label: U.S. Small Business Administration – Plan your business

documents.title: Professional Communication and Document Writing
documents.content: Effective professional writing starts with the reader and the desired outcome. Put the main purpose early, use specific factual language, organise supporting details logically and make the requested action clear. Match tone to audience and channel. Verify names, dates, figures, titles and contact details before sending. Do not invent qualifications, institutional approvals, statistics or endorsements. For formal letters, include a clear subject, respectful salutation, concise context, specific request and appropriate closing. For social posts, make the offer and next step clear without exaggeration.
